Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Electrical Trolley are available?

The Europull Electrical Trolley is available in 5 models: EPET-05, EPET-10, EPET-20, EPET-30, EPET-50. Capacity (Tons) ranges from 0.5 Ton to 5.0 Ton. Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

What capacity range does the Europull Electrical Trolley cover?

The Europull Electrical Trolley covers 0.5t - 5t.

Which standard does the Europull Electrical Trolley comply with?

The Europull Electrical Trolley is manufactured to EN 14492-2 / CE.

What travel Speed does the Europull Electrical Trolley have?

The Europull Electrical Trolley's travel Speed: Dual Speed 11 / 22 m/min or Single 20 m/min.

What power Supply does the Europull Electrical Trolley have?

The Europull Electrical Trolley's power Supply: 3-Phase 380V / 415V 50/60Hz.

What brake System does the Europull Electrical Trolley have?

The Europull Electrical Trolley's brake System: Motor Electromagnetic Disc Brake.
